primaryText: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
verificationNoteJa: 固定WEB 1KI18:31の改名対象と十二部族の説明だけを常時表示し、18:36の祈りは同節根拠のfactに分離。

additionalPrimaryWitnesses.textualBasis: The phrase “God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel” refers to Jacob individually; the following “God in Israel” is a separate collective/territorial expression.
